evals.prompt: Chart what's coming into this node. Neighborhood scores hands it side (object, four values over 12 rows), accessibility (float64) and coverage (float64).
evals.expected_output: A content change of Scores chart holding the starter bar chart: side on x as nominal, accessibility on y as quantitative with an explicit "aggregate": "mean", and no data field.
assertions: The answer proposes a content change of node scores-chart (node.content.write) holding a Vega-Lite spec.
The spec draws "mark": "bar" with side on x as nominal.
The spec puts accessibility on y as quantitative with an explicit "aggregate": "mean".

evals.prompt: Chart this node's input. Hourly counts hands it hour (datetime64[ns]), pedestrians (int64) and cyclists (int64), one row per hour.
evals.expected_output: A content change of Counts chart holding the starter line chart: hour on x as temporal and pedestrians, the first quantitative column, on y as quantitative, with no data field.
assertions: The answer proposes a content change of node counts-chart (node.content.write) holding a Vega-Lite spec.
The spec draws "mark": "line" with hour on x as temporal.
The spec puts pedestrians, the first quantitative column, on y as quantitative, and does not fold cyclists in beside it.

evals.prompt: Chart what comes into this node. Roof sizes hands it roof_id (object, a different id on each of its 12 rows) and VEGETATED_SQFT (float64).
evals.expected_output: A content change of Roofs chart holding the starter histogram: roof_id left out as an identifier, VEGETATED_SQFT binned on x and "aggregate": "count" on y, as a bar mark.
assertions: The answer proposes a content change of node roofs-chart (node.content.write) holding a Vega-Lite spec.
roof_id is on no axis or channel of the spec: the chart draws no bar per roof.
The spec draws "mark": "bar" with VEGETATED_SQFT binned on x ("bin": true or a bin object).
